items.name: alibaba/open-code-review
items.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
items.comment: 阿里混合架构代码评审工具：确定性规则流水线 + LLM Agent，内置 NPE/线程安全/XSS/SQL 注入等跨语言规则集，行级精确评论，兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic。5 万星项目时隔一月回归即登顶，今日仍有推送。

items.name: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src
items.description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices
items.comment: Chrome 团队「现代 Web 指南」源码仓，受众直接写成 coding agent，连续第三日在榜退居第 2，+1,875 为增量王，总星两日翻倍逼近 5,000。

items.name: openai/codex-security
items.description: OpenAI's Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK for finding, validating, and fixing security vulnerabilities. npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@openai/codex-security
items.comment: OpenAI 官方安全漏洞查找/验证/修复 CLI 与 SDK，连续第三日在榜（第 3），总星破 1.3 万，「AI 审代码」叙事持续，今日仍有推送。

items.name: ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis
items.description: LLM 驱动的多市场股票智能分析系统：多源行情、实时新闻、决策看板与自动推送，支持零成本定时运行。 LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system with multi-source market data, real-time news, decision dashboard, automated notifications, and cost-free scheduled runs.
items.comment: LLM 驱动的多市场股票智能分析系统，7.1 万星中文头部项目，掉榜一日即回归，垂类刚需反复上榜能力强，今日仍有推送。

items.name: we-promise/sure
items.description: The personal finance app for everyone (by everyone)
items.comment: 社区共建记账应用，连续第四日在榜，+944 为全榜增量第二，总星破 1.4 万，「by everyone」众包模式是最大卖点，今日仍有推送。

items.name: backnotprop/plannotator
items.description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.
items.comment: 新面孔：面向「人类监督 Agent」的工作区——规划、批注、审代码、团队共享，一键把反馈发回 Agent，补齐 Agent 管理层，1 万星起步，今日仍有推送。

items.name: louislam/uptime-kuma
items.comment: 自托管监控工具常青树久违上榜，9.4 万星仅 +61 星排第 7，排序权重扶持极端样本，今日仍有推送。

items.name: block/buzz
items.comment: 新面孔：Block 开源「蜂群思维通信平台」，Rust 实现 3.7 万星，面向多 Agent/多人信息同步，Agent 基建的通信层拼图，今日仍有推送。

items.name: tradermonty/claude-trading-skills
items.description: Claude Code skills for equity investors and traders — market analysis, technical charting, economic calendars, screeners, and trading strategy development.
items.comment: 新面孔：面向股票投资者的 Claude Code 技能包（市场分析/技术图表/经济日历/选股器/策略开发），技能包赛道换垂类方向回血，今日仍有推送。

items.name: tailscale/tailcat
items.description: like netcat, but over Tailscale's data plane, without Tailscale's control plane
items.comment: 新面孔：Tailscale 官方 netcat 替代品，走数据平面无需控制平面，+324 星排第 10 传播起步；注意最后推送 11-05（停更 8 天）。

items.name: Likely7/Veyra-NRVideo
items.description: Bring PS5 GTA6 to 120FPS with DLSS 5. An advanced Windows video player and capture enhancement tool featuring real-time preview for videos, images, and capture card sources. Combine AI-powered Super Resolution, DLSS5 image enhancement, and Frame Generation to deliver a next-generation visual experience.
items.comment: 新面孔：Windows 视频播放/采集增强工具，AI 超分 + DLSS5 + 帧生成，主打 PS5 GTA6 冲 120FPS，1,574 星小项目靠 +245 增量进榜，最后推送 11-11。

items.name: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp
items.comment: 新面孔：Chrome DevTools 官方 MCP 服务器，把浏览器调试能力开放给编码 Agent，5.5 万星重仓项目，与 modern-web-guidance 构成 Chrome 官方双子星，今日仍有推送。
